exploration.title: Summer Bloom Adoption Project
exploration.summary: Step into the zinnia greenhouse as students raise mystery seedlings, record their growth, and discover what each one-of-a-kind bloom becomes.

image.alt: Pink zinnia blooms from the Summer Bloom Adoption Project.

learningPoints: Care for living plants and notice what they need
Measure change through observation journals and field notes
Compare mystery seedlings as their unique blooms are revealed
